areas.description: The first chamber of Orc Lair B has four orcs immediately inside along with a hobgoblin who joined the orcs after looking for greener pastures. These orcs share duty guarding the local orc temple and have a cruel sense of humor. Each inhabitant has 1d6 sp.
treasure: Each orc and the hobgoblin has 1d6 sp.

areas.description: Only the orc chief in room 13 knows of this secret room. The main chamber contains a cot, food, flint and steel, a skin of water, and a cloak.
areas.trap: Both secret doors into the room are very well hidden and each is trapped in two ways: opening one without disarming it releases gas causing anyone within 10 feet to save vs. Poison or fall asleep for 1d6 hours, and also sounds an alarm loudly for 1 minute in the chief's quarters.

areas.description: Two orcs with spears and hand axes stand guard at this door. The short corridor between this room and the next room provides a buffer zone in case of attack. Each guard has 1d6 sp.
features: Short corridor serving as a buffer zone in case of attack.

areas.description: The wily orc chief resides here, usually with a war leader and two common orcs. The chief has a key to the eastern temple door at room 9 attached to a necklace of long pencil-thin gold bars worth 100 gp. The room contains stout wooden furniture. Under a heavy chair in the northeast corner is the alarm bell that rings if either trapped secret door in room 11 is opened without being disarmed first.
areas.trap: A locked chest has a gas trap inside. When opened without inserting a long pencil-sized object into a hole in back, it releases gas in a 10-foot area; affected creatures save vs. Poison or die (or suffer a similarly nasty effect at the GM's option).
treasure: Necklace of long pencil-thin gold bars worth 100 gp with key to the eastern temple door at room 9.
Locked chest containing 800 gp, 500 ep, 700 sp, and a Potion of Healing.
features: Alarm bell under a heavy chair in the northeast corner linked to the trapped secret doors of room 11.

areas.description: This trash-littered room houses nine orcs. They are currently throwing rocks at one who is standing against a wall while several others are bruised; the game is to see who can take the most beating before flinching. Each has 1d6 sp.
This room houses seven orcs. It is cluttered with miscellaneous debris they have torn up and discarded, as well as firewood and stone circles for cooking.
treasure: A hidden bag with 10 pp and 400 sp in a hole in the northeast corner covered by a stack of fireplace rocks and a foot of earth.
features: Hidden hole in the northeast corner concealed by fireplace rocks and a foot of earth.
